name: premiereremote
description: PremiereRemote - MCP, HTTP, and WS servers for Adobe Premiere Pro UXP
author: sebinside

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && esbuild src/internal/index.ts --bundle --outfile=build/index.js --platform=node --format=iife --external:premierepro && cp -r static/. build/
scripts.dev: pnpm run clean && cp -r static/. build/ && esbuild src/internal/index.ts --bundle --outfile=build/index.js --platform=node --format=iife --external:premierepro --watch
